design.hypothesis: The existing world acquires the previously untrained native set effect from observed transitions by moving only 68 existing scalars, while preserving the previously learned contact and bilingual/lexical predictions.
design.training: Identical fresh 48-event tape at all ten inherited law/seed checkpoints: all eight binary 3-entity anchors, all three addressed slots, both requested bits. Full before/action/after observations; no hidden mode, oracle target, action-effect formula or language label supplied to fitting. One event per episode; all four atomic prior/request tuples covered.
design.challenge: Fresh opaque IDs and coherent five-action repeated-set, alternating-set and set-contact-bridge sequences over 3-6 entities. Set-only duplicate hidden-mode/reversal views omitted. 128 contact-reversal pairs per law. All 1920 actions retained, including 256 ambiguous forecasts. Atomic tuples and both laws are familiar; no unseen atomic truth-table or independent world-replication claim.
design.optimization: Fresh Adam betas .9/.999, eps 1e-8, weight_decay 0, amsgrad false. Mask gradients before clip. Verify the 494-scalar complement bitwise after every step; never restore forbidden changes to conceal them. 256 fixed updates, no loss-based early stopping, selection, extra examples or retries. Retain every seed even when fitting criteria fail.
design.controls: Inherited no-update parent and deterministic no-change control on identical delivered histories. The no-change forecast is computed once per law and explicitly reused across seed labels. No architecture or matched-consumed-compute comparison is claimed.
design.retention: Use unchanged accepted 88-parameter coordinate language weights across six opened banks: bilingual, lexical, binding, saturation, centering and coordinates. Compare with their saved coordinate forecasts, not earlier failed encoders. Zero exact regressions, identical language order probabilities, maximum world-log-probability change <=1e-10. Keep individual probability changes. No old model is refitted or old baseline recollected.
design.criteria: Every law/seed must meet identifiable complete-world and identifiable trajectory/role-pair accuracy >=.95, full coverage, zero unsupported MAP worlds and zero known-fixed-coordinate errors. Mean oracle KL <=.05 in each nonempty family/information stratum, maximum ambiguous TV <=.1. SET NLL <=.05 in every nonempty family/entity-count/prior/request/changed cell, with changed-SET mean NLL improvement >=.1 over parent and no-change. Zero identifiable regressions against parent. Training NLL <=.05 and all six language retention gates must pass. Since unsupported MAP is forbidden, singleton support requires exact correctness despite the .95 floor.
design.probabilities: Unconditioned full joint distributions, no oracle-support truncation or clipped zero probabilities. Ambiguous actual-world errors remain reported but do not alone fail acquisition. Whole-trajectory metrics use actual intermediate feedback and are not autonomous rollouts.
design.publication: Publish source/protocol/data, actual weights, then all raw forecasts in separate commits before the next stage. Remote commit visibility is verified outside the runner. Hashes and same-team review do not constitute independent custody.
design.failure: Exclusive output paths; retain attempts, completed checkpoints, raw records and failure details. Any incomplete update/collection inventory stops without refitting or retry. A completed scientific failure yields REVISE_NATIVE_SET_ACQUISITION, never revised thresholds on the opened bank.
design.limits: Action family, stable identity addressing, requested bit, factorization, two persistent modes and Bayesian filtering are supplied. This tests observed effect acquisition and retention; learned effect selection from words is a later frozen study. No new operator, architecture, workspace or production path. Original G1/G2 scientific gates, G3 full exit and G4 remain unchanged. The inclusive 2000-line research goal remains unmet.

decision_order: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION on incomplete fitting, invalid provenance or missing forecasts
REVISE_NATIVE_SET_ACQUISITION if any completed-fit, competence, probability or retention criterion fails
KEEP_NATIVE_SET_ACQUISITION otherwise; proceed to effect-and-role grounding only in a new frozen tranche
